Missing entries found in review are back-filled from the source correspondence with a note; recurring under-logging is addressed through file-quality coaching.
Field definitions from the PolicyCenter activity data dictionary: activity_date, channel, broker_contact, summary, commitment_flag, subjectivity_reference.
Control total = count of file communication entries reconciles to the count of inbound/outbound broker messages on the portal/email trail for the submission, with exceptions explained.

Acceptance criteria: every material broker communication and commitment is logged contemporaneously with date, contact and summary, and verbal commitments are confirmed in writing within 24 hours. Evidence = the PolicyCenter activity log and correspondence folder in OpenText /underwriting/new-business/<submission-id>/correspondence/.

checklist.step: Maintain an audit trail of communications
